title: Resident Evil Survivor (USA, SLUS-01087) - rocket launcher with unlimited ammo
how: Static verification of the owned disc image. KERNEL.BIN (PS-X EXE, pc0 0x80010b08) loads at 0x80010000; its text disassembly places the GameShark enable-code probes exactly at the documented hook addresses, confirming the load base and the published RAM addresses for the US revision. The weapon table and health are zero-initialized RAM (.bss) on this build, so no disc patch can carry the unlock; it must be applied as session-start RAM pokes after the game builds its state.

session_start_ram_pokes.note: Apply after the boot sequence completes (poll enable-probe bytes above) - never while KERNEL.BIN text is still initializing.

pokes.meaning: health (QoL guard; keeps the session playable for acceptance)

scope: Rocket Launcher with unlimited ammo (the only unlockable content in this US revision: earn S rank on normal difficulty)
not_present_on_disc: G-Con 45 support (ripped from the US build; not unlockable)
Extra characters, modes or costumes (none exist in this revision)
runtime_acceptance: pending: launch the owned CHD in an agent session on an authorized worker, apply pokes, confirm rocket launcher present with unlimited ammo; audio 2%.
source_verification: Disassembly of the owned KERNEL.BIN with the load base cross-checked against both enable-code probes; disc CHD and extracted BIN SHA1s match the catalog hashes recorded on request #2033.
